title: What Helps Language-Model Agents Review Violent Video? A Controlled Comparison with a Human Evidence Reference
abstract: arXiv:2611.26776v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Systems that flag violent video for a human operator can now be built from language models without training, by combining perception models and letting a language model decide. We ask how the observations of the perception models should reach the decision, and which evidence matters. On the XD-Violence test set (799 clips) we fix one set of perception agents (video description, object detection, sound tagging, speech recognition and speech tagging) and one reasoning model, and compare three interfaces: messages between agents, a typed evidence graph explored with tools, and flat text read in one pass; and a single audio-visual model given the raw clip. Two annotators provide a human reference that records the decision, the incident segments and whether they relied on sight, sound or speech. translated_title: 什么能帮助语言模型代理审阅暴力视频？与人类证据参照的受控比较
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2611.26776v1，公告类型：交叉发布）：如今，无需训练即可基于语言模型构建用于标记暴力视频以供人工操作员审核的系统，方法是组合多个感知模型并让语言模型做出决策。我们探讨感知模型的观察结果应以何种方式传递给决策环节，以及哪些证据真正重要。在XD-Violence测试集（799个视频片段）上，我们固定了一组感知代理（视频描述、物体检测、声音标记、语音识别和语音标注）和一个推理模型，并比较三种接口：代理之间的消息传递、通过工具探索的类型化证据图，以及一次性阅读的扁平文本；此外还比较了一个直接接收原始视频片段的单一视听模型。两名标注者提供了人类参照，记录了他们的决策、事件发生的片段，以及他们依赖的是视觉、声音还是语音。结果表明，扁平文本与单一模型的表现相当（F1为0.967对0.968），而证据图代理和消息传递的准确度较低；证据图代理的一个变体……
tldr: 该研究在XD-Violence数据集上进行受控比较，发现将感知模型观察结果整理为一次性阅读的扁平文本是语言模型代理审阅暴力视频最有效的方式，其表现与直接处理原始视频的单一视听模型相当，而消息传递和证据图接口效果较差。
en_tdlr: This controlled comparison on XD-Violence shows that presenting perception-model observations as flat text read in one pass is the most effective way for LLM agents to review violent video, matching a single audio-visual model, while message passing and evidence-graph interfaces are less accurate.
